name: doom
title: DOOM (linuxdoom-1.10, POSIX + Xlib)
_doc: The one target here that is not a DOS program. The Watcom DOS Doom was never published, so the only original source is the Linux one, and the faithful path is to compile it intact and shim POSIX + Xlib. A 'Doom DJGPP' would be a derivative -- which is the one thing this project does not build.
_env: Doom delegates sound to a SEPARATE PROCESS -- `sndserver = popen("./sndserver ", "w")` in i_sound.c, with #define SNDSERV 1 at doomdef.h:84. So popen is not a convenience here, it is the sound architecture. The second process itself is a target of its own (sndserv.json).
